descriptions.preferred: The foliage is a rich purple-red to almost black-red. Young leaves have a characteristic fine silvery white pubescence . The leaf color becomes brown-green in late summer. Fall colors are bright red and crimson. The medium-sized leaves have seven ovate-acuminate lobes, each ending with a sharp tip, and with toothed margins. This cultivar grows rapidly when young, later slows down to reach 13-16 ft. (4-5 m) tall. The name means "black," referring to the leaf color.

rhs.description: A deciduous shrub or small tree with 5- to 7-lobed leaves, deep purple in spring and summer, becoming crimson in autumn

attributes.suggested_uses: Cottage/Informal Garden, Low Maintenance, City/Courtyard Gardens
attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this amoenum group have large, palm-shaped leaves with finely-toothed edges

care.cultivation: Grow in a moist but well-drained soil. Water in summer if necessary. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure
care.propagation: Propagate by grafting or softwood cuttings

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

care.cultivation: 宜种植于湿润但排水良好的土壤中。夏季如有需要应浇水。叶色在半阴环境下表现最佳，但也可耐全日照。土壤水分不足或暴露过度都可能导致叶片焦枯。
care.propagation: 可采用嫁接或软枝扦插繁殖

resistance.pest: 可能易受槭瘿螨、蚜虫、毛虫和七叶树介壳虫危害
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

rhs_zh.description: 落叶灌木或小乔木，叶 5 至 7 裂，春夏季为深紫色，秋季转为深红色。

attributes.suggested_uses: 乡村花园/自然式花园，低维护花园，城市/庭院花园
attributes.hort_group_description: 此 amoenum 类群中的 Acer 品种具有大型掌状叶，叶缘具细锯齿。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 叶色为浓郁紫红至近黑红色。幼叶带有其特征性的细密银白色柔毛。至夏末，叶色转为褐绿色。秋季叶色鲜红至深红。中等大小的叶片具 7 个卵形渐尖裂片，各裂片先端锐尖，叶缘具锯齿。该品种幼年期生长较快，后期生长放缓，最终高达 13-16 英尺（4-5 米）。其名称意为“黑”，指其叶色。
